origin.diagnostic_only_finding: At 0h cooldown RETRIGGER baseline had 43 events, 40 positive, 3 negative, +0.154163 net percentage points, +0.003585 expectancy and PF 1.013014; this was selected post-hoc and is not validation evidence.

purpose: Test whether the movement-state RETRIGGER family, without the rejected 30/60 minute gates, has a stable cost-adjusted edge in an unopened calendar year.

universe.historical_symbol_set: same fixed 24-symbol set used by discovery run 36299204476
universe.survivorship_note: This stage validates the mechanism on the fixed historical set; it is not full-universe production proof.

causality.scanner_rule: frame close_time must be earlier than decision_time

locked_candidate.signal_definition: existing causal movement-state RETRIGGER transition from the archived Botum scanner; no static-value replacement and no parameter refit
locked_candidate.stop: archived source ATR stop fixed at signal time

locked_control.policy: identical target, cost, source stop and expiry
locked_control.role: report-only control; cannot replace the candidate based on 2024 results

decision_rules.pass: Only RETRIGGER may advance, and only if every locked gate passes. Passing opens 2025 forward validation; it does not modify Clear System.py.
decision_rules.fail: Reject setup-kind separation as a production candidate; do not retune the target, cooldown, expiry or gates on 2024 and do not reopen the same threshold family under a new name.
decision_rules.insufficient: Fewer than 120 events is insufficient evidence and does not count as a pass.

action_budget.launch_rule: Do not launch if implementation repeats year data per quarter, omits quarter parallelism, or fails any compile/self-test/static/real-data smoke check.

production_effect: None. Clear System.py remains unchanged until later forward validation, final OOS and r2 OR-union quality tests pass.
